reason: The text demonstrates YHWH's anger directed at the people's failure to properly observe His commandments and laws, specifically regarding Sabbath observance. YHWH's rhetorical question 'How long will you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?' expresses clear displeasure when people violate the law against gathering manna on the seventh day. In biblical Hebrew theology, obedience to God's laws—particularly the Sabbath—constitutes a fundamental form of worship and service to God. The text explicitly connects improper behavior (not keeping the Sabbath) with deficiency in worshiping God properly.
